items.subject: mRNA-1273
items.statement: The proposed INN for mRNA-1273 is elasomeran

items.subject: mRNA-1273
items.statement: mRNA-1273 is classified as Messenger RNA (mRNA), lipid nanoparticle formulated
items.supporting_quote: Chemical Class: Messenger RNA (mRNA), lipid nanoparticle formulated

items.subject: mRNA-1273
items.statement: The route of administration is intramuscular injection

items.subject: mRNA-1273 manufacturing
items.statement: mRNA-1273 drug substance is manufactured at Moderna, Inc.'s facility in Norwood, MA
items.supporting_quote: mRNA-1273 drug substance is manufactured at Moderna, Inc.'s facility in Norwood, MA using in vitro transcription (IVT) technology.

items.subject: mRNA-1273 manufacturing
items.statement: The manufacturing process involves DNA template preparation, IVT reaction, mRNA purification via tangential flow filtration and chromatography, and final formulation
items.supporting_quote: The manufacturing process involves DNA template preparation, IVT reaction, mRNA purification via tangential flow filtration and chromatography, and final formulation.

items.subject: mRNA-1273 drug substance control
items.statement: Purity specification is ≥ 95% full-length, tested by CE-PAGE / HPLC

items.subject: mRNA-1273 drug substance control
items.statement: Residual DNA specification is ≤ 10 ng/mg mRNA, tested by qPCR

items.subject: mRNA-1273 drug substance control
items.statement: Endotoxin specification is ≤ 1 EU/mg, tested by LAL Kinetic Turbidimetric
